note: REVISION after v1 flagged 7 of 9 documents and inspection showed the proxies - not the drawings - were wrong. Calibrated against how the model actually draws: (1) a cross-lane connector must be measured against the DETECTED lane divider, not the canvas midline - process-1's crossing runs y=220->440 while the divider is near y=360; (2) capacitor plates were 56 px apart against an arbitrary 40 px limit, so the limit becomes 0.08 x width; (3) floor-plan walls are FILLED dark rects 32 px thick, with no stroke-width at all, so 'thick_strokes' was measuring a property the drawing never used; (4) blueprint arrowheads are not emitted as SVG markers, so a marker-based dimension check cannot see them and is dropped, recorded as unmeasurable rather than failed. A proxy must be calibrated against the artifact before it is allowed to judge it.

checks.q: two or more horizontal lines spanning at least 60% of the width
a connector spanning the detected lane divider
two parallel plates within 8% of the width (the capacitor)
at least two narrow dark-filled rectangles (walls drawn as solid bands)
exactly one node above all others
